## Overview Add an opt-in sparse FlashMLA decode route for DeepSeek-V4. `VLLM_DS4_DECODE_KERNEL=sparse` gathers compressed and sliding-window KV and uses the sparse FlashMLA path; `paged` stays the default. Missing or unsupported scheduler metadata fails explicitly. The sparse route consumes C4/C128 decode indices and graph-stable metadata from the related P2 changes. No new binding or shared library is added. ## Architecture ```mermaid flowchart LR A["Decode request
+ scheduler metadata"] --> B["Kernel mode
and metadata guard"] B -->|"paged: default"| C["Paged decode"] --> F["Decode output"] B -->|"sparse: opt-in"| D["C4/C128 + SWA
KV gather"] --> E["Sparse FlashMLA
decode"] --> F classDef io fill:#e7f1ee,stroke:#2c9d86,stroke-width:1.5px,stroke-dasharray:5 4,color:#263d36; classDef module fill:#d5e2de,stroke:#abc8bf,color:#263d36; classDef core fill:#0a6953,stroke:#0a6953,color:#ffffff; class A,F io; class B,C,D module; class E core; linkStyle default stroke:#6b817a,stroke-width:1.5px; ``` ## Test H100: **5 targeted decode-routing tests and 1 environment-variable test passed**, using a previously compiled integration extension, not a native build of this isolated branch. Combined-path GPU and model-level evaluation remain pending. On an **unpublished** current-`main` merge candidate, H20 passed the same **5 decode-routing cases** plus the decode-mode environment-variable case. The unrelated upstream P2P environment case also passed. Combined-path GPU and model-level evaluation remain pending. ## H20 integrated end-to-end validation (2026-11-03) This supplement supersedes earlier single-GPU OOM or missing-server attempts **for the integrated DeepSeek-V4 stack only**. It does not claim that this individual PR head alone passes the full-model run. The tested integration commit is `5931b43d3287c1486fb319d1e5687cbe43c8bf00`, combining the V4 split PRs, follow-up integration fixes and the H20 FlashInfer top-k fallback in [inaniloquentee/vllm#6](https://github.com/inaniloquentee/vllm/pull/6). Code and raw logs are confined to `/home/ljj`; no repository test file was added for this validation. H20-3e, TP8, model `/home/ljj/models/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Base`, `VLLM_BATCH_INVARIANT=1`, `VLLM_USE_DEEP_GEMM=1`, `VLLM_DS4_DECODE_KERNEL=sparse`, `VLLM_ENABLE_V1_MULTIPROCESSING=0`. Same model/configuration on upstream main `7651825993d001759107c66cdf6983535900c874` (raw `/home/ljj/vllm-dsv4-main-baseline-20261103/fullmodel-tp-eager-main-2.log`): ```text ValueError: FP8 MoE backend DEEPGEMM does not support the deployment configuration since kernel does not support batch invariance. ``` Main cannot reach a same-BI `lm_eval` or serving benchmark, so there is no comparable main throughput claim. An intermediate integrated stack `71f3d9aa9` with SM100-only DeepSelect on H20 also failed graph capture (raw `/home/ljj/vllm-dsv4-e2e-20261103/e2e-service/server.log`): ```text CUDA error (/workspace/.deps/deepselect-src/csrc/cuda_kernels/v3_fp32/instantiations/../topk_select.cuh:590): no kernel image is available for execution on the device ``` After integrating the H20 dispatch, the exact full-model command runs under the same Slurm eight-GPU allocation. The external test script is `/home/ljj/tmp/run-dsv4-fullmodel-e2e-20261103.sh`; it checks token IDs, generated logprobs and prompt logprobs for 128/512/2048 tokens in three batch positions: ```bash srun --partition=h20 --nodelist=vllm-sgp-h20-03 --gres=gpu:8 --cpus-per-task=64 --mem=512G --time=03:00:00 --export=ALL,REPO=/home/ljj/vllm-dsv4-e2e-20261103,MODEL=/home/ljj/models/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Base,RESULT=/home/ljj/tmp/dsv4-e2e-zero-diff-5931b43d3.json,VLLM_DS4_DECODE_KERNEL=sparse bash /home/ljj/tmp/run-dsv4-fullmodel-e2e-20261103.sh # Repeat with DSV4_E2E_GRAPH=1, DSV4_E2E_EP=1, and both set to 1. ``` Raw final line in each of `/home/ljj/vllm-dsv4-e2e-20261103/fullmodel-tp-eager-7.log`, `fullmodel-tp-graph-5931.log`, `fullmodel-ep-eager-5931.log`, `fullmodel-ep-graph-5931.log`: ```text PASS: 9 full-model exact comparisons PASS: 9 full-model exact comparisons PASS: 9 full-model exact comparisons PASS: 9 full-model exact comparisons ``` Serve the same commit with: ```bash vllm serve /home/ljj/models/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Base --tensor-parallel-size 8 --max-model-len 16384 --max-num-batched-tokens 8192 --gpu-memory-utilization 0.82 --host 127.0.0.1 --port 9256 vllm bench serve --model /home/ljj/models/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Base --dataset-name random --host 127.0.0.1 --port 9256 --random-input-len 8192 --random-output-len 1 --request-rate inf --num-prompts 128 --num-warmups 16 lm-eval run --model local-completions --model_args base_url=http://127.0.0.1:9256/v1/completions,model=/home/ljj/models/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Base,num_concurrent=64 --tasks gsm8k --trust_remote_code ``` Raw `/home/ljj/vllm-dsv4-e2e-20261103/e2e-service-flashinfer/bench-serve.log`: ```text ============ Serving Benchmark Result ============ Successful requests: 128 Failed requests: 0 Benchmark duration (s): 120.00 Total input tokens: 1048576 Total generated tokens: 128 Request throughput (req/s): 1.07 Output token throughput (tok/s): 1.07 Total token throughput (tok/s): 8738.89 ``` Raw `/home/ljj/vllm-dsv4-e2e-20261103/e2e-service-flashinfer/lm-eval-gsm8k.log` (all 1319 questions, five-shot): ```text |Tasks|Version| Filter |n-shot| Metric | |Value | |Stderr| |-----|------:|----------------|-----:|-----------|---|-----:|---|-----:| |gsm8k| 3|flexible-extract| 5|exact_match|↑ |0.9234|± |0.0073| | | |strict-match | 5|exact_match|↑ |0.9234|± |0.0073| ``` No AI-generated performance table: the blocks above are excerpts of the raw logs. The integration SHA and full log paths are provided so the evidence can be audited on the shared H20 devbox. ## Latest-main sparse decode verification (2026-11-03) The prior head `09474c1a1eea655fd5b06c6af25c6d04f2967e34` updated the existing `test_decode_sparse_reuses_prefill_kernel` to cover both non-BI C128 fallback and BI fused C128 dispatch. The previous test inferred fused dispatch solely from the presence of the C++ operator, but the implementation also requires `VLLM_BATCH_INVARIANT=1`. No new test file or operator was added; `git diff --check` and `ruff format --check tests/kernels/attention/test_flashmla_sparse.py` passed. On H20-02 with Slurm, the current nine-PR integration branch `31bd1f2319bb82176743c2e47ec739b477da16b9` (including upstream main `893d65b0a6f9e30e83e1a85a79562250c2dd1059`) ran: ```bash srun --partition=h20 --nodelist=vllm-sgp-h20-02 --gres=gpu:1 --cpus-per-task=16 --mem=128G --time=00:20:00 --chdir=/home/ljj/vllm-v4-nine-prs-20261103 --output=/home/ljj/vllm-v4-nine-prs-20261103/sparse-decode-fixed-sm90.log /usr/bin/env PATH=/home/ljj/vllm-pr-59863/.venv/bin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/local/cuda/bin:/usr/bin:/bin LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/home/ljj/toolchains/gcc13/lib:/usr/local/cuda-13.0/lib64 PYTHONPATH=/home/ljj/vllm-v4-nine-prs-20261103:/home/ljj/deepgemm-dsv4-integration-20261023 /home/ljj/vllm-pr-59863/.venv/bin/pytest -q -rs tests/kernels/attention/test_flashmla_sparse.py -k decode_sparse_reuses_prefill_kernel --tb=short ``` Raw `/home/ljj/vllm-v4-nine-prs-20261103/sparse-decode-fixed-sm90.log`: ```text 4 passed, 40 deselected in 2.25s ``` This is an integrated focused test, not an isolated full-model E2E result for this PR head. The earlier broader run hit stale `_C_cache_ops` (seven vs six arguments) and then `_flashmla_C` (fourteen vs thirteen arguments) binaries. Both extensions were rebuilt from the current source under `/home/ljj/vllm-v4-nine-prs-20261103` without changing a PR source file. The same H20-02 tests on integration commit `62897322a4066542325faaf22ff0c7176e5bf36e` ran: ```bash srun --partition=h20 --nodelist=vllm-sgp-h20-02 --gres=gpu:1 --cpus-per-task=16 --mem=128G --time=00:30:00 --chdir=/home/ljj/vllm-v4-nine-prs-20261103 --output=/home/ljj/vllm-v4-nine-prs-20261103/sparse-decode-rebuilt-both-sm90.log /usr/bin/env PATH=/home/ljj/vllm-pr-59863/.venv/bin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/local/cuda/bin:/usr/bin:/bin LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/home/ljj/toolchains/gcc13/lib:/usr/local/cuda-13.0/lib64 PYTHONPATH=/home/ljj/vllm-v4-nine-prs-20261103:/home/ljj/deepgemm-dsv4-integration-20261023 /home/ljj/vllm-pr-59863/.venv/bin/pytest -q -rs tests/kernels/attention/test_flashmla_sparse.py -k "sparse_flashmla_decode_matches_cache_writer_scales or decode_sparse_reuses_prefill_kernel" --tb=short ``` Raw `/home/ljj/vllm-v4-nine-prs-20261103/sparse-decode-rebuilt-both-sm90.log`: ```text 5 passed, 39 deselected in 2.76s ``` This is a focused integration result, not an isolated PR E2E or serving benchmark. Full-model TP8 verification for the new integration head is queued as Slurm job 5355 and is not yet claimed as passed. ## Contribution and review AI-assisted update. This PR owns opt-in sparse FlashMLA decode, not sparse selection (#60453) or decode-index kernels (#60444). The added assertions stay in the existing test file. The human submitter must review every changed line and confirm the cited test evidence before requesting re-review. DCO and CI status must be resolved by their respective owners; no agent attestation is made for another author. ## Latest-main conflict resolution and focused test (2026-11-03) Current head `09be3836a412a6c5a84aebf107454e3a5942b8c9` merges upstream main `eb239e34c29d8b51bf299aa9d674df5aafa7167f`, retaining this PR's C128 helper before main's new `CombineTopkSwaIndicesKernel`. Final diff: 7 files, +671/-1; no new test file. `git diff --check upstream/main...HEAD` and `ruff format --check` passed. On H20-02, independent source checkout `/home/ljj/vllm-pr60454-main-eb239-20261103` at the exact head, using the locally rebuilt shared vLLM/FlashMLA extensions from `/home/ljj/vllm-v4-nine-prs-20261103`: ```bash srun --partition=h20 --nodelist=vllm-sgp-h20-02 --gres=gpu:1 --cpus-per-task=16 --mem=128G --time=00:30:00 --chdir=/home/ljj/vllm-pr60454-main-eb239-20261103 --output=/home/ljj/vllm-pr60454-main-eb239-20261103/sparse-decode-main-eb239-retry.log /usr/bin/env PATH=/home/ljj/vllm-pr-59863/.venv/bin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/local/cuda/bin:/usr/bin:/bin LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/home/ljj/toolchains/gcc13/lib:/usr/local/cuda-13.0/lib64 PYTHONPATH=/home/ljj/vllm-pr60454-main-eb239-20261103:/home/ljj/deepgemm-dsv4-integration-20261023 /home/ljj/vllm-pr-59863/.venv/bin/pytest -q -rs tests/kernels/attention/test_flashmla_sparse.py -k "sparse_flashmla_decode_matches_cache_writer_scales or decode_sparse_reuses_prefill_kernel" --tb=short ``` Raw `/home/ljj/vllm-pr60454-main-eb239-20261103/sparse-decode-main-eb239-retry.log`: ```text 5 passed, 22 deselected in 4.74s ``` The first attempt on this checkout failed at collection for missing FA2/FA3 symlinks (`sparse-decode-main-eb239.log`); the retry above used pre-existing local build artifacts. This focused result does not establish full-model accuracy or serving performance at this PR head. The separate integrated TP8 E2E job 5355 remains queued.

+@triton.jit
+def _fill_c128_topk_kernel(
+    output_ptr,
+    lens_ptr,
+    output_stride_0,
+    output_stride_1,
+    TOP_K: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    """Materialize graph-stable C128 indices and their invalid tail in one pass."""
+    row = tl.program_id(0)
+    offsets = tl.arange(0, TOP_K)
+    length = tl.load(lens_ptr + row)
+    values = tl.where(offsets < length, offsets, -1)
+    tl.store(output_ptr + row * output_stride_0 + offsets * output_stride_1, values)
+
+
+def fill_c128_topk(output: torch.Tensor, lengths: torch.Tensor) -> None:
+    """Fill C128 local Top-K indices, using -1 for padded entries."""
+    assert output.ndim == 2 and output.dtype == torch.int32
+    assert lengths.ndim == 1 and lengths.dtype == torch.int32
+    assert output.shape[0] == lengths.shape[0]
+    top_k = output.shape[1]
+    if top_k == 0 or top_k & (top_k - 1):
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"C128 top-k width must be a positive power of two, got {top_k}"
+        )
+    _fill_c128_topk_kernel[(output.shape[0],)](
+        output,
+        lengths,
+        output.stride(0),
+        output.stride(1),
+        TOP_K=top_k,
+        num_warps=4 if top_k <= 1024 else 8,
+    )
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _zero_invalid_lens_kernel(
+    lens_ptr, lens_stride, valid_ptr, valid_stride, n_elements
+):
+    row = tl.program_id(0)
+    if row < n_elements:
+        value = tl.load(lens_ptr + row * lens_stride)
+        is_valid = tl.load(valid_ptr + row * valid_stride)
+        tl.store(lens_ptr + row * lens_stride, tl.where(is_valid, value, 0))
+
+
+def zero_invalid_lens(lens: torch.Tensor, is_valid: torch.Tensor) -> None:
+    """Set lengths for invalid tokens to zero without a generic elementwise op."""
+    assert lens.ndim == 1 and lens.dtype == torch.int32
+    assert is_valid.ndim == 1 and is_valid.dtype == torch.bool
+    assert lens.shape == is_valid.shape
+    if not lens.is_cuda:
+        lens.masked_fill_(~is_valid, 0)
+        return
+    _zero_invalid_lens_kernel[(lens.shape[0],)](
+        lens,
+        lens.stride(0),
+        is_valid,
+        is_valid.stride(0),
+        lens.shape[0],
+        num_warps=1,
+    )
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _compute_gather_lens_kernel(
+    seq_lens_ptr,
+    seq_lens_stride,
+    query_start_ptr,
+    query_start_stride,
+    output_ptr,
+    output_stride,
+    n_rows,
+    window_size: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    """Compute decode gather lengths without intermediate elementwise tensors."""
+    row = tl.program_id(0)
+    if row >= n_rows:
+        return
+    query_len = tl.load(query_start_ptr + (row + 1) * query_start_stride) - tl.load(
+        query_start_ptr + row * query_start_stride
+    )
+    seq_len = tl.load(seq_lens_ptr + row * seq_lens_stride)
+    prefix_len = tl.minimum(tl.maximum(seq_len - query_len, 0), window_size - 1)
+    tl.store(output_ptr + row * output_stride, query_len + prefix_len)
+
+
+def compute_gather_lens(
+    seq_lens: torch.Tensor,
+    query_start_loc: torch.Tensor,
+    output: torch.Tensor,
+    window_size: int,
+) -> None:
+    """Fuse decode query-length, clamp, and gather-length elementwise ops."""
+    assert seq_lens.ndim == query_start_loc.ndim == output.ndim == 1
+    assert seq_lens.dtype == query_start_loc.dtype == output.dtype == torch.int32
+    assert seq_lens.shape[0] == output.shape[0]
+    assert query_start_loc.shape[0] == seq_lens.shape[0] + 1
+    if not seq_lens.is_cuda:
+        query_lens = query_start_loc[1:] - query_start_loc[:-1]
+        output.copy_(query_lens + (seq_lens - query_lens).clamp(0, window_size - 1))
+        return
+    _compute_gather_lens_kernel[(seq_lens.shape[0],)](
+        seq_lens,
+        seq_lens.stride(0),
+        query_start_loc,
+        query_start_loc.stride(0),
+        output,
+        output.stride(0),
+        seq_lens.shape[0],
+        window_size=window_size,
+        num_warps=1,
+    )
+
+

+    return int(getattr(hf_config, name, default) or default)

+        swa_k_cache: torch.Tensor,
+        swa_metadata: "DeepseekSparseSWAMetadata",
+        attn_metadata: DeepseekV4FlashMLAMetadata | None,
+        swa_only: bool,
+        output: torch.Tensor,

+        token_start: int = 0,
+        request_count: int | None = None,

+            swa_metadata.num_decodes if request_count is None else request_count

+            torch.ops._C.combine_c128_swa_decode(
